title: NoodlesCD
description: allows to make custom cds to your mc server no limits on anything. allows youtube links or mp3 files from your drive to make a cd. names and other stuff auto made
body:
NoodlesDiscs

Custom YouTube music discs for Minecraft using Simple Voice Chat

NoodlesDiscs lets server owners create custom music discs from YouTube or direct audio links and play them through jukeboxes using Simple Voice Chat. No resource pack is required.

Players can insert a custom disc into a jukebox, hear the song around the jukebox location, and remove the disc to stop the music just like a normal Minecraft music disc.

Features
Create custom discs from YouTube links
Supports direct audio links
Plays music through Simple Voice Chat
No resource pack required
Jukebox-style behavior
Insert disc into jukebox to play
Remove disc from jukebox to stop
Saves YouTube title and creator when available
Custom disc names and lore
OP-only by default
LuckPerms-compatible permissions
Folia-ready
Auto-managed downloader tools
No manual ffmpeg, yt-dlp, or Deno setup needed

Requirements

You only need: Simple Voice Chat
Commands
/noodlescd create <name> <url>
/noodlescd give <player> <name>
/noodlescd list
/noodlescd info <name>
/noodlescd delete <name>
/noodlescd stop
/noodlescd reload
/noodlescd help

Permissions

By default, only OPs can use the commands.
noodlesdiscs.admin
noodlesdiscs.create
noodlesdiscs.give
noodlesdiscs.list
noodlesdiscs.delete
noodlesdiscs.stop
noodlesdiscs.reload

How It Works
An admin creates a custom disc:
The plugin downloads and prepares the audio.
An admin gives the disc:
The player right-clicks a jukebox with the disc.
The disc is inserted and the song plays around the jukebox using Simple Voice Chat.
Right-click the jukebox with an empty hand to eject the disc and stop the song.

Installation
Stop your server.
Install Simple Voice Chat.
Put NoodlesDiscs.jar in your plugins folder.
Start your server.
Create your first disc.

Notes
YouTube support is handled automatically by the plugin.
The first YouTube disc may take longer to create because the plugin sets up its helper tools.
Players need Simple Voice Chat installed on their client.
Only upload or use songs you own or have permission to use.
Very long songs or many jukeboxes playing at the same time may use more server resources.
